022111010012220002112 - ASI: 17

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  000 = 0 * 00
  022 = 0 * 22
  211 = 2 * 11
  0122 = 01 * 22
  1010 = 10 * 10
  000211 = 000 * 211
  111010 = 11 * 1010
  0002112 = 000211 * 2
  20002112 = 2 * 0002112
  022111010 = 022 * 111010
  012220002112 = 0122 * 20002112
  022111010012220002112 = 022111010 * 012220002112
